managed_by.description: Present when the route is enterprise-managed (`managed_by: enterprise`).

rules.action.description: The action if the inclusion_filters matches, default is `send` action.

rules.inclusion_filters.operand.description: Part of CRN that can be compared with values.

rules.inclusion_filters.operator.description: The operation to be performed between operand and the provided values. 'is' to be used with one value and 'in' can support upto 20 values in the array.

rules.inclusion_filters.values.description: The provided string values of the operand to be compared with.

rules.targets.id.description: The target uuid for a pre-defined metrics router target.

backup_metadata_region.description: To backup all your meta data in a different region.

default_targets.id.description: The target uuid for a pre-defined metrics router target.

permitted_target_regions.description: If present then only these regions may be used to define a target.

primary_metadata_region.description: To store all your meta data in a single region.

private_api_endpoint_only.description: If you set this true then you cannot access api through public network.

destination_crn.description: Cloud Resource Name (CRN) of the destination resource. Ensure you have a service authorization between IBM Cloud Metrics Routing and your Cloud resource. See [service-to-service authorization](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/metrics-router?topic=metrics-router-target-monitoring&interface=ui#target-monitoring-ui) for details.

managed_by.description: Identifies who manages this target. Optional at create time. If set to `enterprise`, the target becomes enterprise-managed and can only be modified by identities authorized for the enterprise actions. If omitted or set to `account`, the target is managed by the child account. This value is immutable after creation.

name.description: The name of the target. The name must be 1000 characters or less, and cannot include any special characters other than `(space) - . _ :`. Do not include any personal identifying information (PII) in any resource names.

region.description: Include this optional field if you want to create a target in a different region other than the one you are connected.

name.description: The name of the route. The name must be 1000 characters or less and cannot include any special characters other than `(space) - . _ :`. Do not include any personal identifying information (PII) in any resource names.

The name of the target. The name must be 1000 characters or less, and cannot include any special characters other than `(space) - . _ :`. Do not include any personal identifying information (PII) in any resource names.
